name: Ethylene (polymer feedstock)
why: Base monomer for polyethylene and many polymers

name: Polyimide film (Kapton)
why: Radiation and heat resistant film for insulation blankets and flex circuits

name: Aramid fibre (Kevlar)
why: Slows debris clouds in Whipple shields; overwrap for pressure vessels

name: Vectran liquid-crystal polymer fibre
why: Restraint layer of inflatable habitats and Mars landing airbags

name: Ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene
why: Hydrogen-rich shielding against galactic cosmic rays; strong fibre

name: Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE)
why: Wire insulation, seals and Beta cloth coating

name: Silicone elastomer
why: Seals and gaskets that stay flexible across space temperatures

name: Phenolic resin
why: Matrix of ablative heat shields and carbon-carbon precursors

name: Polyacrylonitrile
why: Precursor fibre for nearly all carbon fibre
